signature.one_line: Slow two-camera interview carried by lower-left stacked word blocks: thin light words plus one heavy accent glowing key word; B&W cold open.
unique_devices: Left-aligned stacked word blocks in the lower-left (x 12-13 %, y 65-85 %): thin Light-300 words in two sizes + one heavy accent key word (~2x) with a dark-indigo glow, hard-cut in 2-3 frames before it is spoken
B&W cold open of the best line lifted from later (~100 frames, key word grey), then a pink-to-second accent gradient flash into the colour question; the line replays in colour later
Literal stock footage composited into the bottom ~40 % of frame under the caption block instead of a full cutaway
Captions as the motion layer: very long takes (median shot ~200 frames, one take ~43 % of runtime) with a slow MCU->CU tighten and an L-cut to the listener
signature.why_it_works: The teaser promises the best line before context; with almost no cuts, the word-by-word blocks and glowing key words supply the motion, so a calm interview still feels edited.

hook.first_frame: guest medium close-up in black-and-white, hand to chin, shallow depth of field; caption block building word by word in the lower left

structure.what: B&W pull-quote of the strongest line, no intro
colour flash into the host's question (profile MCU)
guest's answer; the cold-open line returns in colour
contrast case with stock footage composited under the speaker; slow tighten to CU
big-picture opportunity; L-cut cutaway to the listener breaks the long take
white end card with animated logo, no spoken CTA

pacing.notes: cuts are rare (75 % soft: dissolves / colour flash) but a new caption word lands every ~8-12 frames; pauses tightened under ~10 frames; one take covers ~43 % of runtime

captions.how: left edge x 12-13 %, y 65-85 %, max width 81 %; light lines Inter/Plus Jakarta 300 at 132 px (connective) or 87 px (secondary), each word fades in over 2 frames; tight leading; block hard-cuts out ~3 frames before the next phrase

captions.what: heavy accent key word with indigo glow
captions.how: Poppins / Plus Jakarta 800 ~192 px (shrink to <= 81 % W; ~133 px on host shots), #2E88FE, glow 0 12px 60px rgba(30,25,120,.6); hard cut in 2-3 frames before the word; grey in B&W, second accent once

motion_graphics.how: full-frame gradient flash ~12 frames bridging the B&W cold open into colour

silhouettes_cutouts.what: stock footage composited behind the speaker's lower frame
silhouettes_cutouts.how: literal footage masked into the bottom ~40 % under the caption block, speaker stays above

broll_inserts.when: once, when a concrete thing is named

camera.what: slow digital tighten inside a long take
camera.how: MCU -> CU, ~100 -> 125 % over the take, linear / sine.inOut
guest audio continues over the host listening, breaks a take longer than ~375 frames

end_card.how: near-white bg, animated circular logo ~45 % W centred, no text, no spoken CTA

case.light: lowercase as spoken; sentence-initial capital only at the very start of a thought

grouping.words_per_caption_block: 2-7 words over 2-4 stacked lines (1-4 words per line)
grouping.key_words_per_block: 0-1 (the word that carries the idea: a verb, adverb or concept noun)
grouping.sync: word-by-word build: each word (or short line) is added on its spoken word; the block grows downward
grouping.break: whole block hard-cuts out at the end of the phrase; the next phrase starts a fresh block

layout.stacking: lines stack downward with very tight leading (ascenders of a line touch the descenders of the line above); a short trailing line may be right-aligned or indented under the end of the line above (e.g. indented to x ~40 %)
layout.safe_area: text stays in the lower-left two thirds; never covers the face (faces sit above 55 % H)

light_large.letterform_evidence: double-storey a, single-storey round g, near-circular o/e, very low contrast, thin even strokes (Avenir/Gilroy-light feel); Inter is a grotesque stand-in
light_large.calibration_note: measured over a dark jacket (clean); a 4-word connective line cross-checks at ~138 px (ink 7.11 % H incl. ascenders, 72.6 % W)
light_large.used_for: the first / connective line of a block (articles, pronouns, short verbs)

light_small.letterform_evidence: same face as light_large at ~0.62x size
light_small.calibration_note: an 8-letter lowercase noun measured ink 3.44 % H, 27.8 % W; compute expected ink for any word with fit_font.py at 87 px
light_small.used_for: secondary lines inside a block, mostly in the host's question

key.letterform_evidence: round geometric bowls, double-storey a, round dot on i, straight-cut t top, low contrast; Poppins has a single-storey a (Plus Jakarta Sans is closer)
key.calibration_note: the two words agree (~226-232 px by k formula). Size is NOT fixed (estimated rule): long words shrink to stay <= ~81 % W (an 11-letter word ~171 px); host-shot key words are smaller (see key_small)
key.color: #2E88FE (blue, measured median); grey #8C8C8C in the B&W cold open (estimated); coral #FE664A once for a 'future / change' word
key.shadow: soft dark-indigo glow around/below the word (background under the word shifts from ~#191311 to ~#1E1938 when it appears; e.g. text-shadow 0 12px 60px rgba(30,25,120,.6), estimated)
key.fit_note: Poppins cannot hit height and width together; Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold is closer - re-fit if installed

key_small.calibration_note: fully entered, constant across frames; other host key words ~7.0 % H
key_small.used_for: key words in the host / listener shots (estimated pattern)

animation.light_entry: each word fades in over 2 frames (half opacity on frame 1, full on frame 2), roughly on its word start; no drift, no scale
animation.key_entry: hard cut in (fully opaque, full size in 1 frame) together with its indigo glow, 2-3 frames BEFORE the spoken word
animation.build: block grows line by line downward; existing lines never move
animation.exit: whole block hard-cuts out (no fade) ~3 frames before the next phrase; new block starts empty

captions_spec.notes: Positions, sizes, colours and frame timings measured on video frames (25 fps); font names closest matches (unverified); items marked estimated were not isolated.

other_text_spec.text: same caption system; the key word renders grey #8C8C8C because the whole frame is graded black-and-white
no text; pink-to-orange gradient flash over the frame (~12 frames) between the cold open and the colour question
literal stock footage composited into the bottom ~40 % of frame behind the caption block; captions unchanged
no text: animated brand logo (circular badge, ~45 % W) centred at ~45-55 % height

style.look_intent: high-contrast, natural-saturation, neutral-warm natural skin with shallow depth of field; B&W cold open

sound.music: music bed likely (gap level -7 dB vs speech, periodicity 0.21); voice-led, compressed (LRA 3.2 LU)
sfx: whoosh / shimmer on the colour-flash transition

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

catalog_styles.name: Open-Loop Storytelling with a Delayed Payoff
Layered Collage
catalog_styles.role: stock footage composited under the caption

use_when: a calm two-person interview or podcast with long answers
few camera angles / little B-roll, so captions must carry the motion
a strong quotable line exists that can be lifted for a cold open
a premium, editorial feel rather than hype
avoid_when: fast hype edits or many short clips
Hinglish captions needing larger, simpler reading
busy lower-frame footage that fights left-aligned white text
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B08 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B08.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour/font for each role; keep the contrast relationship: the {{ACCENT}} key word must stay >= 3:1 on the footage, with its dark glow behind it; thin {{TEXT}} words need a dark area behind them)
- {{TEXT}} light caption words - default #FFFFFF
- {{ACCENT}} key word - default blue #2E88FE, with a dark glow tinted from it (default indigo rgba(30,25,120,.6))
- {{ACCENT_2}} one-off key word for 'future / change' moments - default coral #FE664A
- {{SURFACE}} - none (footage)
- {{CARD_BG}} end card - default near-white #F6FDFF
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} key word - default Poppins 800 (Plus Jakarta Sans ExtraBold is closer)
- {{FONT_BODY}} light words - default Inter 300 (Plus Jakarta Sans Light is closer)
- {{HANDLE}} - @handle (not shown in this blueprint; optional on the end card)
- {{LOGO}} - animated circular logo on the end card (~45 % W)

Canvas 1080x1920, 25 fps.

EDIT
1. Cold open (~100 frames): lift the strongest line from later in the interview, grade it black-and-white, no intro (first word within ~3 frames); then a ~12-frame pink-to-orange gradient flash into the colour question. Replay the line in colour where it really occurs.
2. Let takes run long (median shot ~200 frames); tighten slowly inside a long take (MCU -> CU, ~100 -> 125 %); break any take longer than ~375 frames with an L-cut to the listener. Soft dissolves (~8-12 frames) between speakers; tighten pauses under ~10 frames.
3. When the speaker names a concrete thing, composite matching footage into the bottom ~40 % of frame under the caption block for ~100 frames instead of cutting away.
4. End: ~75 frames {{CARD_BG}} card with {{LOGO}} animated, centred at 45-55 % H, no text.

CAPTIONS
5. Latin script, lowercase as spoken (capital only at the start of a thought), no punctuation, no emoji.
6. Blocks of 2-7 words over 2-4 stacked lines, left-aligned at x 12-13 %, ragged right, max width 81 %, first line top at y 65-66 %, band y 62-85 %; very tight leading (ascenders touch the descenders above); a short trailing line may indent under the end of the line above. Never cover the face (faces above 55 % H).
7. Light words: {{FONT_BODY}} 300, {{TEXT}}, no shadow/stroke/box; connective / first line 132 px, secondary lines 87 px. Each word fades in over 2 frames (half, then full) on its spoken word; no drift/scale.
8. Key word (0-1 per block, the word that carries the idea): {{FONT_DISPLAY}} 800, -0.02em, {{ACCENT}}, ~192 px on the main speaker (shrink long words to stay <= 81 % W), ~133 px on the host / listener; dark glow 0 12px 60px; hard-cut in, full size, 2-3 frames BEFORE the spoken word. In the B&W cold open it reads grey (#8C8C8C); use {{ACCENT_2}} once for a 'future / change' word.
9. Block grows downward line by line, existing lines never move; the whole block hard-cuts out ~3 frames before the next phrase.

GRADE: Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: high-contrast, natural-saturation, neutral-warm skin, shallow depth of field; B&W for the cold open only.
SOUND: voice at about -14 LUFS over a low bed; whoosh/shimmer on the colour flash; no cut hits.

VERIFY before rendering (px values were render-verified with Inter / Poppins; with the closer Plus Jakarta Sans, re-fit px until the numbers match):
a) Render test frames over a dark area: "because" ({{FONT_BODY}} 300, 132 px), "online" and "frankly" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 800, ~192 px, {{ACCENT}}), "digital" ({{FONT_DISPLAY}} 800, 133 px), and "KEY WORD" in {{FONT_BODY}} 300 at 87 px.
b) Measure: python video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test render or snapshot> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.62,0.95,0.86 --ink "{{TEXT}}:60,{{ACCENT}}:80" (tighten --box per line).
c) Required: "because" ink 5.47 % +-0.5 of H and 41.7 % +-2 of W; "online" 8.83 % +-0.5 and 53.8 % +-2; "frankly" 11.64 % +-0.5 and 60.3 % +-2 (Poppins misses one axis - prefer the closer face); "digital" 7.97 % +-0.5 and 37.6 % +-2. For the 87 px tier compute expected ink with python video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "<{{FONT_BODY}}>" --word "KEY WORD".
